sample_checks.description: User views a product with ≥80% completion, export UI is enabled
steps: Navigate to product with 100% completion (product-0001 from Phase 2A tests)
Verify CompletionCard displays 100%, status 'ready'
Verify ExportGatePanel shows 'Export Ready' with no blocking reasons
Click 'Export' button and confirm no errors

sample_checks.flow_name: Partial Product - Export Blocked with Reasons
sample_checks.description: User views a product with 40-80% completion, export UI is disabled with clear blocking reasons
steps: Navigate to product with 60% completion (product-0005 from Phase 2A tests)
Verify CompletionCard displays 60%, status 'partial'
Verify ExportGatePanel shows blocking reasons (e.g., 'Missing required attributes')
Verify 'Export' button is disabled
Hover over disabled button to see tooltip with reason

sample_checks.flow_name: Blocked Product - Export Blocked with Details
sample_checks.description: User views a product with <40% completion, export UI is disabled with detailed blocking reasons
steps: Navigate to product with 40% completion (product-0007 from Phase 2A tests)
Verify CompletionCard displays 40%, status 'blocked'
Verify ExportGatePanel shows detailed blocking reasons with segment breakdown
Verify 'Export' button is disabled
Verify segment breakdown shows missing attributes and content items

sample_checks.description: Admin user views read-only completion rules versions history
steps: Navigate to /admin/completion-rules
Verify versions list displays all historical versions
Verify each version shows timestamp, author, and rule count
Click on a version to view details (read-only)
Verify no edit buttons present (read-only enforcement)

sample_checks.description: User toggles 'Advanced / site details' to view site-specific completion data
steps: Navigate to product page
Locate 'Advanced' or 'Site details' toggle
Click toggle to expand site-specific completion breakdown
Verify GlobalModeCard displays site-scoped readiness data
Toggle back to default view and verify state persists
